data.name: Isaelina
data.gender_notes: Isaelina is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Isaelina is a variant of the Hebrew name Eliana. El means 'God' and ana means 'help' or 'grace'. In the Bible, Eliana is mentioned as a prophetess who dedicated her son to God. Her name symbolizes God's assistance and provision in times of need. The name Isaelina carries the meaning “God's help” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Isaelina usually hope their child will grow to embody god's help and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Isaelina belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's help.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Isaelina total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_greek.name: Ισαελίνη
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ισαελίνη προέρχεται από τις ελληνικές λέξεις 'Ισα' (σωτήρ) και 'ελίνη' (θεός). Σημαίνει 'Ο Θεός είναι Σωτήρ' ή 'Ο Θεός είναι 구원'. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, το όνομα αυτό συνδέεται με την έννοια της σωτηρίας και της θεότητας.

in_latin.name: Isaelina
